findings.issue: File deletion on replace—no error recovery
findings.description: If a file is missing from disk when deleteFile() runs during an update, the operation continues silently after logging the error. A concurrent delete or external disk operation could leave database URLs pointing to missing files. Consider logging this more prominently or propagating cleanup failures to the caller.

The verification report states 'Frontend builds successfully' but this could not be independently confirmed; build output was truncated. A prior build dist folder exists, suggesting the code was built at some point, but the status of the current codebase is unclear.
